invariants.contract: POST chapters with a different number of chapters replaces the list with ids 0..n-1, stores it in books.chapters and metadata.json, answers {success,updated:true} and emits item_updated with the chapters. An empty chapter list clears the stored chapters and metadata.json chapters.
